rd.title: Readings
rd.about: Files shown above the papers while you grade, like the reading or the prompt. They stay in this browser and are never sent back to students.
rd.hint: For a student with a different reading: untick the everyone file above, then add theirs.
rd.card_all: shown with every paper, not sent back
rd.card_one: only for this student, not sent back
rd.hidden: Hidden for this student. Readings… brings it back or adds a different file.
rd.zoom_how: Pinch or Ctrl + scroll on the reading to zoom. Drag the bottom edge to make it taller.
rd.grip: Drag to make the reading taller or shorter
rd.cant: This file can’t be shown here.
rd.no_room: This browser is out of room to keep {name}
rd.added_n: {n} files now show above every paper
rd.tr_redo: Make the existing ones again too
rd.tr_about: Runs in this browser (nothing is uploaded). The speech engine downloads once (about 150 MB). Keep this tab open while it works; you can keep grading in the meantime.
rd.tr_all_have: Every recording already has a transcript

rd.tr_failed.one: {n} couldn’t be read (try Chrome, or convert it to .mp4 or .m4a).
rd.tr_failed.other: {n} couldn’t be read (try Chrome, or convert those to .mp4 or .m4a).
